## Checklist

- [ ] Rules are specific. No broad words like "ai" on their own that would hide human content.
- [ ] Selectors use durable anchors (id, aria-label, role, stable data-*), not churn-prone class names.
- [ ] I ran `bash scripts/sync-list.sh` after editing the list, and committed the regenerated module.
- [ ] I ran `npm test` and it passes.
- [ ] No tracking, no new permissions, no network calls added.
